cards.title: Identity-Based Habits
cards.body: 92% of resolutions fail because they target outcomes, not identity. Instead of "I want to read more," think "I am a reader." Olympic athletes train identity first, results follow. Ask yourself: who do you want to become today?
cards.visualDirection: minimal line art, mirror, warm light
cards.quote: Every action is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
